# Get Blob Base Fee [fee.getBlobBaseFee]

Returns the base fee per blob gas (in wei).

## Usage

This example returns the base fee per blob gas (in wei).

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"91f70c862f700704756fec5504fd855d093d9afbe559b22fca6f27e6c3850e24","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const blobBaseFee = await client.fee.getBlobBaseFee()
// @log: 1n
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"aa681d51f429dd004311e0a12058d19883bbcd18b8489cdb4b6a4357a214822c","data":""}
import { Client, http, publicActions } from 'viem'
import { mainnet } from 'viem/chains'

export const client = Client.create({
  chain: mainnet,
  transport: http(),
}).extend(publicActions())
```

:::

### Standalone Action

Call `Actions.fee.getBlobBaseFee` directly by passing the Client as the first argument.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"035f8c38226c6032751c9cf742548a19e6323d880b65b419df29a33118d0d729","data":""}
import { Actions } from 'viem'
import { client } from './viem.config'

const blobBaseFee = await Actions.fee.getBlobBaseFee(client)
// @log: 1n
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"c9a30e9f3d7225700d3efd99269ce07aeeda73d895d8a6a2533d4146c63987e5","data":""}
import { Client, http } from 'viem'
import { mainnet } from 'viem/chains'

export const client = Client.create({
  chain: mainnet,
  transport: http(),
})
```

:::

## Return Value

`bigint`

The base fee per blob gas, in wei.
